headline: U.S. Airstrikes Hit 80+ Iranian Military Sites, Cancel Sanctions Relief
subheadline: U.S. aircraft struck over 80 Iranian missile, air‑defense, and naval facilities in Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island, and Sirik, causing explosions and fires.
lede: U.S. warplanes bombed more than 80 Iranian military installations, including missile systems, air‑defense sites and naval facilities across Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island and Sirik, triggering explosions and fires. The strikes prompted Washington to cancel Iran’s sanctions relief and reinstate oil export restrictions after attacks on Hormuz shipping. Meanwhile, funeral processions for Ayatollah Khamenei began in Najaf as regional tensions soared.

sections.title: Russia’s Massive Drone Assault Strikes Kyiv Region
sections.body: Russia launched 123 UAVs overnight, of which Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 108 while 12 reached ten locations. The attacks included Shahed drones from Chernihiv and Vyshneve targeting Kyiv’s western suburbs such as Vyshhorod, Irpin, Bucha, Obolon and Lukianivka. Separately, Ukrainian drones destroyed eight Russian shadow‑fleet tankers, a dry cargo ship and a ferry in the Azov Sea, degrading logistics to occupied Crimea. Russian KAB strikes on Kharkiv’s Shevchenkivskyi district killed one civilian and wounded six.

sections.title: U.S. Airstrikes Hit Iranian Military Sites
sections.body: U.S. aircraft bombed over 80 Iranian missile, air‑defense and naval installations in Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island and Sirik, causing explosions and fires near naval facilities. The strikes led Washington to cancel Iran’s sanctions relief and reimpose oil export restrictions after attacks on Hormuz shipping. Israeli forces conducted operations in Hebron and Kiryat Arba, locating a suspect after gunfire reports, while Lebanese artillery and airstrikes hit Nabatieh and Brashit, generating 138 alerts.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The coordinated U.S. airstrikes on more than 80 Iranian military targets and the massive Russian drone wave of 123 UAVs demonstrate a rapid escalation of long‑range combat across the Middle East and Eastern Europe. Iran’s funeral processions for Ayatollah Khamenei began in Najaf amid heightened regional tensions, and Lebanese alerts totaled 138 as Israeli forces conducted operations in Hebron and Kiryat Arba.
